reviews.comment:
El motivo es el estado de los baños, el de hombres no tiene puerta y le faltaba limpieza y el de mujeres, dos baños solos habilitados, es muy poco.
Por otro lado, si bien son muy muy amables el personal del bar, se hace mucha fila con poco espacio y lento.
Le agradezco el interés en mejorar. Se que fui en vacaciones, quizas eso hizo que esté lleno el lugar, pero una opcion es reforzar la asistencia en temporada. Por ej, al pedir café, que no sea la misma empleada la que cobra y lo prepara.
Gracias nuevamente por el contacto.

(Translated by Google)
The reason is the state of the restrooms. The men's restroom doesn't have a door and was dirty, and the women's restroom only has two working stalls, which is very inadequate.
On the other hand, while the bar staff are very friendly, the line is very long, with little space and slow service. I appreciate your interest in improving. I know I went during vacation, which may explain why the place was so crowded, but one option would be to increase staffing during peak season. For example, when ordering coffee, the same employee shouldn't be the one to take payment and prepare it.
Thank you again for contacting me.
